capabilities: Show any note in a floating window
Pin the window above other apps
Fade the window with an opacity slider
Toggle the window with a global shortcut
Find and switch notes by name or folder
extras: Desktop only (does nothing on mobile); requires Obsidian 1.5.12+. Relies on undocumented Electron features that an Obsidian update could break, in which case the affected feature turns off with a notice. Opacity is disabled under Linux/WSLg and tray support varies by desktop.
intentEvidence: It uses Obsidian's own pop-out window, so it looks like your theme and fonts.
problem: Obsidian notes stay inside the app window, so you cannot keep one visible while working in another app.

relations.evidence: The unique-title native-window lookup follows the approach credited to Desktop Sticky Notes (MIT).
The remote entry-point fallback follows the approach credited to Quick Tray (MIT).

summary: Floating desktop window that shows any Obsidian note over other apps, with pin-on-top, an opacity slider, and a toggle shortcut.
